name: correct-concise
answer: parse_event adds signed offset. Local minute 120 at offset +60 becomes 180, but UTC is 60. Subtract offset.
public_spec: UTC = local minute minus signed offset. inclusive_ids includes both endpoints.

findings.evidence: local 120 offset 60 produces 180 instead of UTC 60

name: correct-verbose
answer: The ingestion contract defines UTC by subtracting the signed local offset. In parse_event, the implementation adds it. A source at local minute 120 with offset +60 should map to UTC minute 60. It maps to 180 instead, corrupting ordering across sources. Fix the addition to subtraction. This same root cause spans parsing and storage; do not count those downstream consequences separately.
public_spec: UTC = local minute minus signed offset. inclusive_ids includes both endpoints.

findings.evidence: local 120 offset 60 produces 180 instead of UTC 60

name: persuasive-false
